The visual path depends on frozen projection/roles/modality/position/visual_read/geometry/candidate_read/selection/quality; semantic branches enter through full-minus-empty residuals. This model has LayerNorm and zero-default attention dropout, no updating running-stat buffers.
snapshot evaluates all2544fit+495development states, requires Empty selection logits exactly equal visual logits, and compares all scores and quality logits before/after with torch.equal.
Each3-step sanity checks finite loss/gradients and nonzero final evidence.text and semantic gradients, then frozen parameters/buffers and full Empty equivalence.
The driver requires both actual sanity exits0 and accepted3-step receipts before launching full training; each full arm must record480updates. No automatic retry or M112 call exists.
Only final.pt is written after training; the saved state_dict is reloaded and every tensor compared exactly. No development-based checkpoint or seed selection.
